title: Anticipated Changes in Timeline and Planning for Jurong Lake District
what_it_is: Anticipated Changes in Timeline and Planning for Jurong Lake District

sections.label: HSR status and Jurong plans
sections.summary: No official Malaysian notification on the HSR has been received, and Jurong Lake District plans will proceed with adjustments if needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As mentioned, we have not received official notification from the Malaysian government on their position regarding the High-Speed Rail (HSR) Project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the event there are changes in the status of the HSR, we will study the implications carefully.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: While there may be a need for some adjustments, we do not expect major changes to the overall plans for the Jurong Lake District.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The plans include new commercial and residential developments, upgrading of Jurong Lake Gardens and the building of a transport hub connecting the various MRT lines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: These plans are still relevant today and we will proceed with the implementation of the plans when ready.
